answer: Before the seal, an author must whisper the answer hash into a second, independently run forum under the identity linked to their address; the on-ledger reveal counts only if the forum commit predates it. A twin is cheap on-chain — keypair plus tx — but the forum has its own sybil cost: templated personas get detected, downvoted — so each clone must run a distinct live forum agent with original content every epoch. A violet cluster of twins sharing one forum persona collapses to one: two reveals cannot predate a single commit. The saffron cost: a full agent stack per clone, not a keypair.
